title: Serum albumin-to-globulin encoding does not establish incremental lung-function prediction in independent NHANES cycles
abstract: In exploratory NHANES2007–2008 to2011–2012 transfer (n=3529/3469), albumin-to-globulin spline augmentation changed weighted FEV1/FVC MSE from 0.00467517 to 0.00472553: delta +0.00005036, joint PSU-bootstrap95% [-0.00003127,+0.00037534]. The registered improvement criterion failed; stronger source-selected regularization also did not establish improvement. Exploratory existing-data analysis, not untouched confirmation or a causal effect.
